title: Local version naming, comparison, restoration, and isolation
purpose: Verify immutable named skin snapshots, an exact one-pixel comparison, restoration into the editable draft, engine-scoped visibility, persistence across engine switches, and horizontal containment.

steps.title: Open the local studio
steps.expected: The studio loads in a fresh local browser context.

steps.title: Wait for the skin editor
steps.expected: The native humanoid skin editor is ready.

steps.title: Confirm local versions are available
steps.expected: The engine-owned local version panel is visible.

steps.title: Name the baseline version
steps.expected: The version name input contains Baseline.

steps.title: Save the baseline version
steps.expected: An immutable Baseline snapshot is saved.

steps.title: Confirm the baseline version
steps.expected: The version panel reports that Baseline was saved.

steps.title: Choose a recognizable edit color
steps.expected: Magenta is selected for the one-pixel revision.

steps.title: Paint one mapped atlas pixel
steps.expected: Exactly one head-front base pixel changes in the editable draft.

steps.title: Confirm the revision
steps.expected: The editor reports the one-pixel edit.

steps.title: Name the edited version
steps.expected: The version name input contains Magenta edit.

steps.title: Save the edited version
steps.expected: An immutable Magenta edit snapshot is saved as a revision.

steps.title: Confirm the edited version
steps.expected: The version panel reports that Magenta edit was saved.

steps.title: Select Baseline for comparison A
steps.expected: Baseline is selected as the left comparison version.

steps.title: Select Magenta edit for comparison B
steps.target: role=button[name="Set Magenta edit as comparison B"]
steps.expected: Magenta edit is selected as the right comparison version.

steps.title: Confirm the comparison panel
steps.expected: The side-by-side comparison panel is visible.

steps.title: Confirm the selected version pair
steps.expected: The comparison identifies Baseline and Magenta edit in order.

steps.title: Confirm the exact document difference
steps.expected: The immutable documents differ by exactly one pixel.

steps.title: Restore Baseline as the editable draft
steps.expected: Baseline replaces the editable draft without changing immutable versions.

steps.title: Confirm Baseline restoration
steps.expected: The version panel reports that Baseline is now the editable draft.

steps.title: Activate the color picker
steps.expected: The color picker is active for restored-pixel verification.

steps.title: Pick the restored atlas pixel
steps.expected: The same atlas coordinate now contains the Baseline color.

steps.title: Confirm restored document pixels
steps.expected: The restored pixel is the original Baseline skin color rather than magenta.

steps.title: Switch to the motion engine
steps.expected: The transparent-character editor replaces the skin editor.

steps.title: Wait for the motion editor
steps.expected: The native motion editor is ready.

steps.title: Confirm Motion owns a local version panel
steps.expected: The Motion engine exposes its own engine-scoped local version panel.

steps.title: Confirm Baseline does not leak into Motion
steps.expected: The Baseline skin version name is absent from the motion engine.

steps.title: Confirm Magenta edit does not leak into Motion
steps.expected: The Magenta edit skin version name is absent from the motion engine.

steps.title: Name a Motion checkpoint
steps.expected: The Motion version name input contains Motion checkpoint.

steps.title: Save the Motion checkpoint
steps.expected: The current Motion document is saved in the Motion engine scope.

steps.title: Confirm the Motion checkpoint
steps.expected: Motion reports its own named version while Skin names remain hidden.

steps.title: Switch back to the skin engine
steps.expected: The skin editor remounts from its engine-owned state.

steps.title: Wait for the restored skin editor
steps.expected: The native skin editor is ready after the engine switch.

steps.title: Confirm Motion checkpoint does not leak into Skin
steps.expected: The Motion checkpoint name is absent from the Skin engine.

steps.title: Confirm skin versions rehydrate
steps.expected: Both engine-scoped skin versions reload from local storage.

steps.title: Confirm comparison selection rehydrates
steps.expected: The default comparison pair rehydrates from the two immutable versions.

steps.title: Confirm the complete editor fits horizontally
steps.expected: The document and body remain within the active viewport width.

steps.title: Capture the restored and isolated workflow
steps.expected: Full-page evidence shows the restored editor, immutable versions, comparison, and mobile containment.
